# BetterFriend 0.7.0
- Adds **My people**, an optional shortcut list for up to ten important people. - Makes My people easy to reach from the menu-bar window and offers it once after the first successful manual scan. It requires no Track or cadence setup. - Lets you choose from ten editable draft styles before opening Messages. - Keeps My people separate from Today recommendations, cadence, and reminders. - Improves first-run guidance for Messages sync, Full Disk Access, standard macOS accounts, relaunching, and scan failures. - Carries My people between Macs only when you explicitly include the people category in an encrypted profile. Matching uses anonymous tokens; names, phone numbers, and email addresses are not exported. - Strengthens import previews, recovery copies, accessibility, narrow-screen layouts, and dark-mode contrast.
BetterFriend still never sends messages for you. Message content remains on your Mac and is never attached to update checks or feedback.

# BetterFriend 0.6.3
- Keeps setup available until the first successful scan, even after choosing Not now. - Shows visible scan progress and distinguishes not scanned, missing Contacts, no local Messages history, recovered data, and genuinely caught up. - Makes installation safe for both administrator and standard macOS accounts, preserving the previous app if replacement fails. - Explains the standard-account administrator prompt, Messages sync, and the required relaunch in the first-run setup itself. - Improves keyboard focus, disclosure controls, and native button target sizes. - Adds a direct tester setup path and a privacy-safe Setup report.
BetterFriend still never sends messages for you. Relationship data and message content are never attached to update checks.

# BetterFriend 0.6.2
- Makes encrypted preference imports apply exactly what the preview showed. - Prevents scans and preference transfers from overwriting each other's changes. - Keeps automatic relationship suggestions from becoming manual choices on another Mac. - Improves import previews, Undo, recovery, and encrypted export reliability. - Strengthens privacy checks, release checks, and fictional-data testing.
BetterFriend still never sends messages for you. Relationship data and message content are never attached to update checks.
